description: Fan out one editable .mcpx source into per-material variants under an explicit output directory, each starting from the pristine source so reruns stay byte-identical.

families.description: Palette family ids, one variant per entry, each starting from the pristine source.

materials.description: Builtin material ids, one variant per entry, each starting from the pristine source.

nameTemplate.description: Output filename template using {stem} and {name}; defaults to {stem}_{name}.

outputDir.description: Explicit output directory receiving <stem>_<material>.png plus .mcpx per material.

region.description: Limit the write to one region id.

selection.description: Scope pixel writes with a selection expression.

sourcePath.description: Editable .mcpx source path to fan out from.

style.description: Style preset id or .style.json path; defaults to vanilla.

name: create_variants
